description: Shrink a PDF, mostly by resizing its pictures. low keeps print quality, medium (default) suits the screen and email, high is smallest. A PDF that cannot get smaller comes back unchanged. Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the PDF there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the PDF. A result link from another YangOpen tool works too.

name: compress_pdf
title: Make a PDF smaller
